options.name: Everyday Coastal

violations.message: Two work zones are very close together
Less than 900mm of continuous prep bench

options.rationale: A clean, practical coastal layout with the sink kept close to the existing plumbing, a tall pantry for groceries, and a fridge space at the end of the run. Drawers give a clear landing and prep zone between washing and cooking, while the crisp white cabinetry, white benchtop and stainless bar handles are bright and easy to wipe down.

options.name: Appliance-Led Prep

violations.message: Two work zones are very close together
Less than 900mm of continuous prep bench

options.rationale: This appliance-led option makes the built-in oven and microwave easy to access in a dedicated tall tower, while keeping the sink aligned with the existing plumbing. A wide drawer bank provides the largest practical prep and storage zone available in this compact single-wall room. The fridge sits at the run end, away from the entry door, for straightforward daily use.

options.name: Compact Storage Balance

violations.message: Two work zones are very close together
Less than 900mm of continuous prep bench

options.rationale: A balanced everyday layout that keeps the fridge at the end of the single wall, places the sink close to the existing plumbing, and gives the centre of the kitchen to a broad drawer-based prep zone. The cooktop follows at the far end for a simple left-to-right workflow. Wall cabinets and the extra-door base cabinet add flexible storage without making this compact room feel heavy.

syntheticReactions: I can see how the room questions shape the result, but I want clearer guidance when my measurements are only approximate.
The three-option result is useful because I can compare layout priorities instead of starting from a blank 3D canvas.
On a phone I need the progress, back action and main button to remain visible without crowding the design.
I need the estimate to explain what is included before I decide whether this is within reach.
The shown band of $7,500–$9,500 feels indicative; inclusion and GST labels will decide whether I trust it.
